## Description {#details}

The <a href="https://micro-os-plus.github.io">µOS++</a> Framework represents the primary project, encompassing multiple source libraries. These libraries are managed as separate repositories on GitHub and are collectively maintained under the <a href="https://github.com/micro-os-plus">micro-os-plus</a> group.
